'''Huifarn''' is the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital capital] of [[Verusa]], a two-time [[FLLA World Cup]] champion ([[1724 FLLA World Cup|1724]] and [[1760 FLLA World Cup|1760]]) and the ninth-largest national economy by nominal [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|GDP]] in the world. The city had a population of 5,080,000 at the [[Verusa|Verusan]] 1764 census, ranking it the [[List of cities and dependencies by population|eighty-second-largest city in the world]] by population. The Estadio Huifarn was the principal venue of the [[1744 FLLA World Cup]], including the final between [[Lycroa]] and [[Easuhura]] on 4 July 1744.
